acceptance: A lane that changes only .github/workflows/required.yml runs go/internal/ciparity in its floor, proven by a test through the real floor entry point that is red without the change
A guard fails when a test package reads a repo data file that no registry row names
fix: Design first (docs-write, then an architecture review). Candidate: one registry that maps a path glob to the test packages that read it (for example .github/workflows/* to internal/ciparity), derived where possible from the os.ReadFile and embed sites of each test package, and checked by a guard so that a new reader cannot skip its row. The lane floor and the ship gate run the packages that the changed paths select.
source: console, 2026-11-12, pipeline health investigation: main red since cf5215daf (cycle 2324), fixed by PR #1412
summary: Cycle 2324 changed .github/workflows/required.yml and shipped. Its floor ran only the tests of the Go packages it changed. internal/ciparity reads required.yml as data, so no step selected it, and main went red for 6 CI runs while 5 more lane ships landed on it. The same gap holds for each test that reads a data file: workflow YAML, policy.json, manifests, docs indexes.
title: The lane floor selects the test packages that read a changed non-Go file
